name: passwo-authentication-onboarding
description: Research-grade foundation for the PassWo supportive authentication onboarding and local between-subjects study runtime.

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @passwo/study-server build && pnpm --filter @passwo/study-web build && pnpm --filter @passwo/study-desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm check:biome && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:research-boundary
scripts.desktop:dev: node ./scripts/build-reference-artifact.mjs && node ./scripts/verify-reference-artifact.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm exec electron-forge start apps/study-desktop
scripts.desktop:package: node ./scripts/build-reference-artifact.mjs && node ./scripts/verify-reference-artifact.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @passwo/study-desktop run package
